items.title: DoubleTake: Focused Verification of Visual Evidence for Long-Document Understanding
items.summary: In long-document question answering, a vision-language model can answer incorrectly even when the retrieved pages contain sufficient evidence. Rereading those pages with the original question gives the model little guidance about which fact to check. items.title: ParseBench-2: Severity-Aware Evaluation of Document Parsing

items.title: Benchmarking Multilingual Document Understanding in Vision-Language Models
items.summary: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform strongly on multimodal tasks, Document Understanding (DU) among them, but the benchmarks that measure them mostly cover English documents and narrow problems.
